title: North Coast Parasail & WaterSports

services.name: Parasail Ride
services.desc: North Coast Parasail gives guests the chance to fly high above the water and enjoy unforgettable views of Cedar Point, Lake Erie, the beach, the amusement park, and the surrounding coastline. Guests enjoy elevated views of Lake Erie, Cedar Point Beach, the amusement park, and the surrounding coastline from the air. Parasailing offers a smooth and thrilling experience that combines the exhilaration of flying with breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. With a gentle takeoff and landing right from the boat deck, participants can easily enjoy the adventure without the need for any special training or extensive preparation. services.name: Kayak Rentals
services.desc: Delight in a self-guided kayak tour as you explore the serene waters of Lake Erie. Park on the shore for a lovely picnic or simply savor the tranquility of the calm waters and breathtaking views. North Coast Parasail offers kayak rentals for guests seeking a relaxing, active way to enjoy the water near Cedar Point Beach in Sandusky, Ohio. Kayaking provides a slower-paced way to spend time on Lake Erie with family or friends. Rent a kayak for half an hour for just $30! services.name: Jet Ski Rentals
services.desc: Rent Yamaha WaveRunners and enjoy speed, sun, and waves on Lake Erie near Cedar Point Beach. North Coast Parasail & Jet Ski offers Yamaha WaveRunners for guests who want to cruise across Lake Erie and enjoy the speed, sun, and excitement of personal watercraft rentals. Each WaveRunner can seat one or two people, making jet ski rentals a great choice for individuals, couples, friends, and family members looking for water activities in Sandusky. services.name: Boat Charters
services.desc: North Coast Parasail offers boat charters aboard a Pursuit ST 310 center console, providing a comfortable way to cruise Lake Erie, visit nearby islands, swim, and relax. Guests can visit popular islands like Put-In-Bay or Kelleys Island, enjoy a leisurely day, stop for meals, drop anchor for swimming, and customize their trip around the lake. North Coast Parasail uses a Pursuit ST 310 center console, which the website describes as an excellent choice for cruising and entertaining. The boat is available for up to six guests.
